# PM call with President Trump of the United States: 7 September 2026

The Prime Minister spoke to the President of the United States, Donald Trump, this afternoon.

From:
:   Prime Minister's Office, 10 Downing Street and The Rt Hon Andy Burnham MP

Published:
:   7 September 2026

 

The Prime Minister spoke to the President of the United States, Donald Trump, this afternoon.

The Prime Minister began by wishing President Trump a happy Labor Day.
